verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail documents self-service forwarding. Plans include mail forwarding, users can request mail be shipped directly instead of scanned, and packages can be shipped to any address with bundling. It also offers automation rules for handling mail, though these are not explicitly tied to forwarding. missing for 10: evidence of one-click forwarding, saved recipient address book, carrier/shipping-method choice, cost shown before confirmation, rule-based forwarding specifically, independent/hands-on corroboration.
